result.title: Capture the accepted workspace baseline
result.acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Start the accepted v0.2 client and v0.1 server with two disposable accounts. Inventory the account API, stable IDs, homes, profile.json and preference keys.

**Verify** · Record revisions, launch commands, routes and observed Homes, Projects, Apps, reader and settings. Identify the accepted base before copying product code.

**Delivery dependencies** · Accepted v0.2 workspace and v0.1 server baseline.

**Queue** · First item in the v0.3 queue.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
